title: Add `orchestrator install <target>`: scaffold a target repo with the committed .orchestrator and .claude files and a .mcp.json rooted at ORCH_ROOT=target
spec:
Why: ROOT is ORCH_ROOT or this repo (orchestrator/__init__.py:5); worktrees (spawn.py:57 ensure_worktree), hooks (.claude/hooks via _lib.sh orch_root), prompts (STATE/prompts), bus and merge all hang off it, and `git worktree add` only carries committed files. To run goals on another repo (first: /Users/k3ntaw/code/kgpt) that repo needs a committed scaffold. Implement `orchestrator/install.py` with `install(target: Path, orch_repo: Path = REPO_OF_THIS_PACKAGE) -> list[str]` (lines "created ...", "kept ...", "updated ...") and wire `install <target>` into cli.py (argparse, next to merge).
Behaviour: target must be a git toplevel, else exit 2 with a message. Create/refresh: `.orchestrator/pool.toml` (copy, kept if present), `.orchestrator/prompts/*` (copy, always updated), `.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt` (copy; rewrite the three lines under "the guardrails themselves" to the target's own .claude/hooks, .claude/settings.json and protected-paths.txt paths), `.orchestrator/memory/{decisions,gotchas,model-notes,architecture}.md` (header-only files, kept if present), `.orchestrator/plan.md` (empty checkpoint template, kept), `.orchestrator/tasks/.gitkeep`, `.claude/hooks/*` (copy, executable bits preserved, always updated), `.claude/settings.json` (copy; if the target already has one, write `.claude/settings.orchestrator.json` instead and print a note), `.claude/skills/**` and `skills/**` (copy, always updated), every `.mcp*.json` of the orchestrator rewritten so each `uv run` command becomes `uv run --project <orch_repo> ...` and gets `"env": {"ORCH_ROOT": "<target>"}` (github server entry copied unchanged), and append the missing lines of this repo's .gitignore ignore set (wt/, .orchestrator/bus.sqlite*, .orchestrator/runs/, .orchestrator/pool_state.json, .orchestrator/merge.lock, .orchestrator/bus.lock, .orchestrator/daemon.lock, graphify-out/, .mcp.json) to the target .gitignore without duplicating existing lines. If the target has a Makefile with `test:`, `lint:` and `typecheck:` targets, write an executable `.orchestrator/tests.sh` (kept if present) that runs `set -euo pipefail; make lint; make typecheck; make test` and, when clients/web/package.json has a typecheck script, `(cd clients/web && npm run typecheck)`. Idempotent: a second run reports only "kept"/"updated", never overwrites plan.md, memory, pool.toml, tests.sh or an existing settings.json. Print the list and finish with the two next steps for the human: commit the scaffold in the target, and start the Planner with ORCH_ROOT=<target>. Document the command in README.md "Use on a project" (replace the current two-sentence paragraph). No new dependencies.
acceptance: tests/test_install.py: installing into a scratch_repo target creates .orchestrator/{pool.toml,prompts,protected-paths.txt,memory,plan.md,tasks}, .claude/hooks (executable), .claude/settings.json, .claude/skills, skills, and a .mcp.json whose orchestrator and bus entries use `uv run --project <orch_repo>` and env ORCH_ROOT equal to the target

tests/test_install.py: a target with a Makefile containing test/lint/typecheck targets gets an executable .orchestrator/tests.sh; one without gets none; a target with an existing .claude/settings.json keeps it and gets .claude/settings.orchestrator.json

tests/test_install.py: a second install run leaves plan.md, pool.toml and memory contents byte-identical and its report contains no 'created' line; protected-paths.txt in the target names the target's own hooks path; .gitignore gains the ignore lines exactly once
`uv run orchestrator install /nonexistent` and installing into a non-git directory exit non-zero with a one-line message
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` is green

result.summary:
Done. Committed on `task/T-0070` (d410503), gate green (92 tests + hooks pass).

**Summary:** Added `orchestrator install <target>` to scaffold the §9 orchestrator layout into another git repo, since `git worktree add` only checks out committed files.

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/install.py` (new) — `install(target, orch_repo=PACKAGE_REPO) -> list[str]`. Validates target is a git toplevel (exit 2 otherwise). Copies/generates `.orchestrator/{pool.toml,prompts,protected-paths.txt,memory,plan.md,tasks/.gitkeep}`, `.claude/{hooks,settings.json,skills}`, `skills/`, rewrites every `.mcp*.json` (`uv run` → `uv run --project <orch_repo>`, adds `env.ORCH_ROOT`, leaves `github` untouched), appends missing `.gitignore` lines, and conditionally writes an executable `.orchestrator/tests.sh` when the target has a Makefile with `test`/`lint`/`typecheck`. Idempotent: `plan.md`, `pool.toml`, memory files, `tests.sh`, and an existing `settings.json` are never overwritten.
- `orchestrator/cli.py` — wired `install` subparser next to `merge`; prints the report plus the two human next-steps.
- `tests/test_install.py` (new) — 5 tests covering scaffold creation + mcp rewrite, Makefile gating, existing-settings.json handling, second-run idempotency, and nonexistent/non-git exit codes.
- `README.md` — replaced the "Use on a project" paragraph with the `install` workflow.

**Test output:** all green, no failures (`Ran 92 tests ... OK`; `tests-green.sh` exit 0).

Also manually smoke-tested against a real scratch repo at `/tmp/install-smoke` (now cleaned up) — confirmed executable bits survive, `.mcp.planner.json` rewrites correctly, and a second run reports only `kept`/`updated`.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
